name: scholarx-agent
description: Universal Research Paper API — single entry point for arXiv, PMC, bioRxiv, medRxiv, PsyArXiv, OSF, and Semantic Scholar

capabilities.name: Graph Flow Execution
capabilities.description: Execute a workflow through the agent's graph orchestration engine

capabilities.name: Epistemic Answer
capabilities.description: Answers epistemic_status/why/what_changed queries over the shared knowledge graph: calibrated confidence, evidence/source citations, belief justification trees, bitemporal valid/tx history, and policy-redaction-aware provenance.

tools.description: Run complex multi-step workflows via Pydantic-Graph
